name: list_collage_shapes

description: Shows the looks of a Collager.ai photo mosaic (one large picture made of hundreds or thousands of small photos) with example images: soft classic, clean subject, stronger mosaic, uniform or mixed tile sizes. Use before start_photo_mosaic when the user wants to choose a style.
name: list_mosaic_styles

annotations.title: Make a photo collage (heart, number, word...)

description: Builds a photo collage in the shape of a heart, a number (age, anniversary, year), a word, a star, a flower and more from the user's photos, and returns a watermarked preview within seconds. Use when the user asks for a heart collage, a birthday/anniversary number collage, a 'photo collage in the shape of ...', or a collage from several photos. Pass the photos as public links in photo_urls, or as files the user attached (photos). 1 to 300 photos; if there are fewer photos than cells, photos repeat. The result id (clg_...) is a private handle valid for 30 days; photos and results are deleted after 30 days. The preview is watermarked; the full-resolution file is downloaded from the collager.ai page given in full_resolution_page. Building can take up to a minute - if status is still processing, call get_shape_collage with the id.

gap_pct.description: White gap between photos, % of a cell (default 6).

photo_urls.description: Public http(s) links to the photos (JPEG/PNG/WEBP).

photos.description: Photos the user attached in the chat.

Examples: {"type":"heart"} (size picked from the photo count), {"type":"heart","cells":70}, {"type":"number","text":"30"}, {"type":"text","text":"LOVE"}, {"type":"love"} ("I love you"), {"type":"star","size":"large"}, {"type":"grid","n":4}. Call list_collage_shapes for all options.

annotations.title: Start a photo mosaic on collager.ai

description: Gives the link where the user builds a photo mosaic: one main photo recreated from many small photos (best with 100-2000 photos - family archive, wedding, team, school year). The user uploads the photos on collager.ai, picks the style, and the site builds a watermarked preview in minutes. Call it only after the user has decided to make a photo mosaic; to show the options first, use list_mosaic_styles.

occasion.description: Optional: what it is for (anniversary, memorial, wedding, team ...), used only to tailor the tips.

style.description: Optional: the style the user picked in list_mosaic_styles (the site shows a preview of several styles anyway).

name: start_photo_mosaic
title: Start a photo mosaic on collager.ai
